items.q: Do you have a free plan?
items.a: We don't offer a free plan. Our Pro plan gives you full access for 1 month upon payment via PIX.
Payment is made via PIX QR Code. After payment, you get access to the Pro plan for 30 days. There's no automatic debit — each renewal is done manually via QR Code.
Simple: just don't pay next month's QR Code. No cancellation process, no hassle, no fees. Access expires naturally after 30 days.
Yes. Your data is encrypted and never shared with third parties. We take your privacy very seriously.
When you import your OFX statement, our AI analyzes the name of each transaction and automatically suggests the most appropriate category, saving you time.
